policy.no_trade_rule: Permanent account/infrastructure unlocks that change island throughput, farm perk state, Orthen island buff windows, Agility section gates, or missing Prif district hubs. Do not mirror every animal breed, every harp retune percent, or every VoS tooltip.

policy.rs3_terminology: Ranch Out of Time = Anachronia Dinosaur Farm. Roar of Osseous is the 65-minute island buff from fully restored Rex skeleton (Osseous), not the Osseous boss. Harmonic dust (harps) ≠ harmony dust (waterfall) ≠ harmony moss (Meilyr pillars).

activity_additions.name: Anachronia base camp building-by-building permanents
requirements: Anachronia base camp tutorial with Giles (anachronia:base-camp)
Town Hall tier gates all same-tier structure upgrades; skill gates on Spa / Hunter Lodge / Slayer Lodge / Player Lodge are unboostable
Rare tier-3 mats: essential oils (Spa), reinforced dinosaur pelt (Hunter Lodge), dinosaur tooth (Slayer Lodge), dinosaur rib bone (Player Lodge)
unlocks: First-class per-building residual above anachronia:base-camp-structure-rewards blob (Fort Forinthry-style scoring parity)
Town Hall T1–T3: unlocks same-tier buildings; compacted resource deposits 100/200/400; visitor stores general → armour/weapon → gem/rune
Storehouse T1–T3: resource caps 25k / 80k / 150k per type (5k pre-storehouse)
Sleeping Quarters T1–T3: +5 / +15 / +30 workers (900 / 1,800 / 3,600 resources/hour at full assignment, 60 per worker per hour)
Bank chest upgrade (replaces Town Hall deposit box), Anachronia lodestone, remote totem access point (Remototem management)

Skill lodges remain specialised: Spa Agility/pools (anachronia:spa-pools), Hunter Lodge BGH (anachronia:hunter-lodge), Slayer Lodge damage/helmet stand and Player Lodge skillcape rack on combat/support rows
region_pressure: Hard Anachronia for every base-camp structure.
Forinthry optional: Fort Command Centre T2/T3 adds +5/+5 workers (max 70 with Sleeping Quarters T3) — not Anachronia-local buildings.
activity_additions.notes: Does not re-emit anachronia:base-camp or anachronia:base-camp-structure-rewards. Prefer this id when ranking individual building permanents; keep structure-rewards for compact tier math. Spa tier effects live on anachronia:spa-pools / anachronia:essential-oils.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Anachronia infrastructure residual. Fort worker bonuses are optional Forinthry pressure only.

40 / 70 / 90 unboostable Hunter for lodge tiers 1 / 2 / 3

activity_additions.name: Anachronia Dinosaur Farm elder animal perks
requirements: Ranch Out of Time / Anachronia Dinosaur Farm access (anachronia:ranch-out-of-time)
Farm totem placed on a pen with at least one elder animal, OR completed breeding log for that animal category (grants tier-1 passively since Jan 2024)
Tier-2 large-dino perks need two large pens with elders + totems (second large pen deed at 104 Farming / 1,000 beans)
unlocks: Fourteen Anachronia-only farm perks (frogs through Pavosaurus) as permanent account buffs while conditions are met

Skilling highlights: Flycatcher (double stinkshroom yield), La La La La (+5% salamander Hunter XP), The Old Black Magic (+30s juju duration), Envenomed (10% 4-dose weapon poison/antipoison), Arcane Elements (+1/+2 elemental runes-per-essence), Living Mountain / Powerful Beast (geode + critical swing Mining), Butterfly Effect (Guthixian butterfly chance on produce), Steak Out (extra BGH meat), Rep-tile (+5%/+10% Farming Guild reputation)

Combat-adjacent ranch perks (King of Beasts bomb conserve, No Fear Meteor Strike crit, Armoured Hide Barricade ticks, Stubborn Regenerate) stay on this residual for farm-completion scoring — not separate combat rows
Small/medium Anachronia pens cannot reach tier-2 (only one pen each)
region_pressure: Hard Anachronia for ranch pens, dinosaur species, and Anachronia-only perk set.
Kandarin optional: Manor Farm tutorial/shared bean economy and farm totems from either market.
activity_additions.notes: Does not re-emit anachronia:ranch-out-of-time hub, beans market, or animal buyers. Breeding-log passive tier-1 is the ironman long-tail path. Do not invent proc rates beyond wiki.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Anachronia ranch residual. Value elder dino logistics when scoring Anachronia Farming.
